''Qırmızı-qaralar'' (The Red-blacks) | founded = {{Start date and years ago|df=yes|2005|05|04}}, as ''Qabala'' | ground = [[Gabala City Stadium]] | capacity = 3,748 | chairman = [[Fariz Najafov]] | manager = [[Jeton Beqiri]] | league = [[Azerbaijan Premier League]] | season = [[2025–26 Azerbaijan Premier League|2025–26]] | position = 11th of 12 | website = {{URL|http://www.gabalafc.az}} | pattern_la1 = _jomatoletum2rb | pattern_b1 = _jomatoletum2rb | pattern_ra1 = _jomatoletum2rb | pattern_sh1 = _jomaliga19br | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = _jomatoletum2wr | pattern_b2 = _jomatoletum2wr | pattern_ra2 = _jomatoletum2wr | pattern_sh2 = _joma19wr | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Qəbələ İdman Klubu''' ({{IPA|az|ɡæbæˈlæ|pron}}),[https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/93628--gabala/ Gabala SC][https://gabalafc.az/az/ Qəbələ İK] is an [[Azerbaijan]]i professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Qabala]], which has competed in the [[Azerbaijan Premier League]] since 2006. They will be set to play in the [[Azerbaijan Premier League]] from the 2025–26 season following their promotion from the [[Azerbaijan First Division]] in 2024–25. Gabala has been the runner up in the Premier League three times and has won the [[2018–19 Azerbaijan Cup|national cup]] twice, in 2019 and 2023. Gabala is one of the 2 teams that started the first qualifying round of the [[UEFA Europa League]] for 2 seasons and managed to move on to the group stage.{{Cite news|title=Gabala in Europa League group stage number crunching|work=Gabala FK|url=http://gabalafc.az/eng/news/gabala-in-europa-league-group-stage-number-crunching-2701}}{{Cite news|title=Europa League group stage number crunching|work=[[UEFA Europa League]]|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0230-0e94d27e686b-40cbb86c3206-1000--europa-league-group-stage-number-crunching/?referrer=%2Fuefaeuropaleague%2Fnews%2Fnewsid%3D2398518}}"}}
